name: MS-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Trent Kelly running with large cash advantage
No polls or expert ratings; markets price Kelly at ~96%
model.rationale: The district's R+18 lean, Kelly's incumbency and roughly doubled fundraising, and Polymarket pricing near 96% Republican all point to a safe Republican hold. Challenger Johnson's modest war chest gives little reason to move off the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any surprise polling showing Johnson within single digits, or major outside spending in the district, would warrant a relook.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Trent Kelly seeks another term in a northeastern Mississippi district that leans heavily Republican, about eighteen points to the right of the nation. Kelly has out-raised Democrat Cliff Johnson roughly two to one and holds a large cash advantage, with no significant outside spending reported on either side. Johnson, a Democratic official, has run a credible but underfunded campaign, and a Libertarian is also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Kelly about a 96% chance of winning. With the incumbent favored by double digits in a low-attention contest, the seat is expected to remain safely in Republican hands.
